answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The juniper holds work receipts rather than names, so the orchard of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the spiral of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
